title: EvalSpec — declarative evaluation specification (Blueprint B § 2.1)
description: Content-addressed via content_hash. State machine: draft → published → deprecated (deprecated reversible to published). Mutable in draft; immutable once published.

assertions.description: Typed assertion expressions. Class union LOCKED additively per deferral-A (bd_000-projects-gzgj): a named-class discriminated union plus an open extension slot. Per-class `target` payload stays open (refined at the validator layer per engagement).

scoring.description: Scoring configuration. aggregation_rule is the spec-bound field per Blueprint B § 2.1. weight_dimension/weights/tiebreaker are the deferral-C lockup (bd_000-projects-21re), additive + optional. § 7.6 architectural rule: ship/no-ship THRESHOLDS belong in consumer-side tests/TESTING.md, NOT here — only weights + exact-tie resolution are kernel-side.

weight_dimension.description: Dimension the weighted rule distributes over (deferral-C, bd_000-projects-21re). Required when `weights` present; ignored otherwise.

weights.description: Per-unit weights for the weighted rule (deferral-C). Normalized by their sum at scoring time.

tiebreaker.description: Deterministic resolution of an exact aggregate tie (deferral-C). NOT a threshold — it resolves a tie, it does not set a pass bar.

extensions.description: Tool-specific scoring metadata. MUST NOT drive ship/no-ship decisions (mirrors § 7.4 metadata rule).

composition.description: DAG declaration per Blueprint B § 1.3. Validation contract: runtime topologically sorts; cycles rejected at submission with 400. Wire format (adjacency list with typed edges) is engineer's choice per bd_000-projects-3sjx; semantics ARE spec-bound (node types + edge kinds + failure propagation per § 1.3 line 100).

kind.description: Node type per Blueprint B § 1.3 line 92.
Edge type — drives runtime failure-propagation per Blueprint B § 1.3 line 100.

expected_artifacts.description: SkillSnapshot.combined_sha values this spec targets. Anchors on CONTENT (sha), not FK — rebuilt snapshots with the same combined_sha still satisfy.

runtime_limits.description: Resource ceilings applied per EvalRun per Blueprint B § 2.1.

tenant_id.description: RESERVED multi-tenancy slot (deferral-G, bd_000-projects-k0fj). OPTIONAL + additive per § 7.2; tenant-isolation semantics deferred to a future DR. v1 single-tenant specs omit it.
